asr.full_text: Should you HODL or Invest Bitcoin? HODL means to hold onto your cryptocurrency rather than selling it. Bitcoin was created in 2009. 11 years later, the value of a bitcoin has gone from a few cents to around the $10,000 level currently. While the value of the actual bitcoin has changed over the 11-year period, 1 BTC is still 1 BTC, regardless of its current value. Bitcoin has changed over the 11 year period, one Bitcoin is still one Bitcoin regardless of its current value. The question is, should you hodl or invest your Bitcoin? Hodling may seem like an option, but hodling one Bitcoin for 10 years still means you only have one Bitcoin in 10 years time. What if you invested that one Bitcoin? What would the result be after 10 years? If you could get just 10% profit per annum, and compound for 10 years, you would have 2.59 bitcoin in that 10 year period What if you could receive 10% profit, or more, every month. Imagine how your bitcoin will grow? With the MirraTrading International Platform, the system endeavors to make good monthly profits so that your Bitcoin will grow. Your Bitcoin remains with the brokers and your bitcoin is traded using advanced trading software. There are no fees and the company and traders only make an income if they make a profit for you This is really an investment game changer Mirror Trading International allows you to grow the number of Bitcoin you are holding You also stand to benefit from the growth in the value of Bitcoin and you may add to or withdraw from your account at any time How much are you hodling? Ask yourself again – Is this wise? I don't think so. For more information please contact the person who sent you this video.
